Container.Name: StandUpOrderGenerator
Container.Overview: Stand-Up Order Generator — randomize daily stand-up order for development teams with multi-pod support, keyboard navigation, per-person timers, a daily facts panel, and one-click screenshot to Teams.

Config.Name: WebUI Port
Config.Description: Port the web interface is available on.

Config.Name: Data Path
Config.Description: Persistent storage for settings, session logs, and facts cache.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User ID for file ownership. Use 99 for Unraid nobody user.

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group ID for file ownership. Use 100 for Unraid users group.

Config.Name: TZ
Config.Description: Timezone for date and time display.

Config.Name: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY
Config.Description: Optional Anthropic API key for AI-powered daily facts. Leave blank — app works without it.
